purpose: Pinned upstream inputs for a bounded object-selection feasibility study; no production model is adopted.

notes: Official checkpoint licensing explicitly covers the model weights.
Microsoft's existing SAM2 exporter names the original SAM2 configurations, so SAM2.1 export must be qualified separately.
Use cached full-image features, positive/negative points, boxes and previous mask logits where supported.
The checkpoint is supplied in the upstream Apache-2.0 repository; retain its upstream license and provenance with any downloaded artifact.
The upstream decoder has a six-point cap and truncates extra points; the research adapter must refuse excess prompts explicitly.
The upstream PyTorch full-size sampler is bicubic while its ONNX wrapper uses bilinear. Compare low-resolution logits and qualify one shared reconstruction path.

executionPolicy.modelDownloadRequires: successful strict native-WebGPU session and known-tensor execution gate
executionPolicy.cpuReference: explicit diagnostic only after the GPU gate; never an automatic retry or production fallback
artifactRequirements: Record exact downloaded file size, SHA-256, source URL and source revision before loading.
Record exported model SHA-256, exact environment, input/output names, shapes and numerical comparison result.
Do not report segmentation quality or supported hardware from the synthetic runtime probe.
